questions.text:
🎵 I Have To — Listening
Ascolta tutta la canzone e clicca: nelle strofe la risposta giusta (attenzione: do / does, non am / is!), nel ritornello la parola giusta: have to, must, mustn't o don't have to. Niente da scrivere!

question.text:
🎧 I Have To
🎤 INTRO
This is another hit
Sing with me

🎵 VERSE 1
Do you have to hide your feelings? [[Yes, I do|No, I'm not|No, I don't]]!
Do you have to follow your dreams? [[Yes, I do|No, I don't|Yes, I am]]!
Do you have to please the whole world? [[No, I don't|Yes, I do|No, I'm not]]!
Do you have to learn to be kind? [[Yes, I am|No, I don't|Yes, I do]]!
Do you have to fear your mistakes? [[No, I'm not|No, I don't|Yes, I do]]!
Do you have to stand up again? [[No, I don't|Yes, I do|Yes, I am]]!
Do you have to copy others? [[Yes, I do|No, I don't|No, I'm not]]!
Do you have to find your own way? [[Yes, I am|Yes, I do|No, I don't]]!

🔁 CHORUS
I [[have to|must|mustn't|don't have to]] build my future,
I [[have to|must|mustn't|don't have to]] try to do my best!
I [[have to|must|mustn't|don't have to]] judge the others,
Put my kindness to the test!
I [[have to|must|mustn't|don't have to]] be so perfect,
I [[have to|must|mustn't|don't have to]] win the cup,
We [[have to|must|mustn't|don't have to]] walk together,
So please, don't give it up!

🎵 VERSE 2
Does he have to hide his sadness? [[No, he isn't|No, he doesn't|Yes, he does]]!
Does she have to speak her own mind? [[Yes, she does|Yes, she is|No, she doesn't]]!
Does he have to be the strongest? [[Yes, he does|No, he doesn't|No, he isn't]]!
Does she have to follow her heart? [[No, she doesn't|Yes, she is|Yes, she does]]!
Does he have to walk all alone? [[No, he doesn't|Yes, he does|No, he isn't]]!
Does she have to help a good friend? [[Yes, she is|Yes, she does|No, she doesn't]]!
Does he have to stop his journey? [[No, he isn't|Yes, he does|No, he doesn't]]!
Does she have to keep on trying? [[Yes, she does|No, she doesn't|Yes, she is]]!

🔁 CHORUS × 2
(come sopra: cantalo!)
